tools.name: list_book_categories
tools.description: List publisher-managed public book category slugs and names. Use a returned slug as category in search_books. Categories may have no matching books; empty lists mean categories have not been maintained. Never invent category assignments.

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: List or search published books. Omit q to browse all records. Returns the public REST representation, pagination totals and next/previous REST links; increment page to continue. Books include categories, publisher-maintained overall availability (unknown is not unavailable), and structured purchase_

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Retrieve one published book by its catalog ID, obtained from search_books or a related record. Returns exactly the public REST detail fields, publication-filtered relationships and public page/media links. Unpublished and unknown IDs both return not found. Books include categories, publisher-maintai
